title: Critique of the Khafre pyramid SAR scan model

tellings.quote: they took a visual 3D model of the king's chamber and the relieving chambers and they they um they duplicated it five times inside the coffer pyramid and they said this is what they're detecting.

plain: In 2025 a team linked to a researcher named Filippo Biondi used radar imaging (SAR, a satellite radar method that can build pictures of what lies under a surface) and announced structures inside the Khafre pyramid, one of the great pyramids at Giza in Egypt. A researcher named Luke Caverns says they did not really detect anything new: according to him, they took a 3D model of the king's chamber and the small chambers above it in a different pyramid, copied it five times inside Khafre, and said "this is what they're detecting." He tells it as his own critique of how the result was presented.
